recipient.text: third parties who are not our service providers
recipient.name: third party

conditions: To the extent The New York Times Company “sells” your personal information (as the term “sell” is defined under the CCPA)
exceptions: opt-out of that “sale” on a going-forward basis at any time
opt-out from the “sale” or “sharing” of your personal information with third parties who are not our service providers

click the "Your Privacy Choices" link on the bottom of the webpage where your information is being collected or go to “Account” and then “Settings,” and “Privacy Settings” and click the “Your Privacy Choices” link there
submitting a request to opt-out by emailing us at privacy@nytimes.com with the subject line “California Resident - Do Not Sell or Share.”
turn on the Global Privacy Control to opt-out of the “sale” or “sharing” of your personal information
